descricao_original: Usually pseudostratified columnar epithelium lines prostate glands, although simple epithelia may also be present. The height of the epithelium will vary depending on the activity of the gland. A fibromuscular tissue surrounds each gland. Prostatic concretions accumulate with age in the prostate. 800x, 400x
creditos_identificados: Image source: The right image was taken of a slide from The University of Michigan collection.
